4Islands Epic | Official Announcement

After careful consideration, we have made the difficult decision that the 4Islands Epic will not form part of the Epic Series calendar in 2027.

Over the last 11 editions, 4Islands became one of the most unique mountain bike stage races in the world, creating unforgettable experiences, lasting friendships and memories that will stay with us for years to come.

We are incredibly proud of what the event achieved and of the memories created along the way, from spectacular racing and breathtaking landscapes to lasting friendships and legends made.

We would like to thank the local authorities, communities, partners and volunteers who have supported the 4Islands Epic throughout its journey. Your commitment, passion and dedication have been instrumental in making the event such a special part of the Epic Series.

While 4Islands will not form part of the Epic Series calendar in 2027, we remain committed to delivering exceptional racing and unforgettable experiences at iconic destinations around the world.


2027 Epic Series Calendar

Absa Cape Epic: 21 to 28 March 2027

Andorra Epic: 1 to 4 July 2027

Swiss Epic: 17 to 21 August 2027

FNB Wines2Whales: 3 to 12 November 2027

 

Explore the Epic Series races: epic-series.com/races

Welcome to the most unique MTB race!

Where the sea and rocks meet Krk, Cres, Unije and Lošinj!

Krk, Cres, Unije and Lošinj form the most unique race arena in mountain biking. Rocks, roots and open water, the Kvarner region challenges every team across five days of racing unlike anything else in the world. Kvarner islands in Croatia are as beautiful as they are tough, and thousands of mountain bikers have left their blood, sweat and tears on these trails with the aim of becoming Epic. 

This is 4Islands Epic, where islands are stages and the sea plays hide and seek, and where you'll discover what it's like to race one of the best MTB stage races in the world, with everything included. Let's Conquer the Rocks!

Over the last 11 editions, 4Islands became one of the most unique mountain bike stage races in the world, creating unforgettable experiences, lasting friendships and memories that will stay with us for years to come. 

 

 

We are incredibly proud of what the event achieved and of the memories created along the way, from spectacular racing and breathtaking landscapes to lasting friendships and legends made.

 

 

We would like to thank the local authorities, communities, partners and volunteers who have supported the 4Islands Epic throughout its journey. Your commitment, passion and dedication have been instrumental in making the event such a special part of the Epic Series.
